findings.description: Terraform state file is not encrypted. State files may contain sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Enable server-side encryption for your Terraform state backend.

findings.rule_name: Run Docker Container as Non-Root User
findings.description: Docker container is running as root user, which poses security risks.
findings.recommendation: Add USER directive to run container as non-root user.
findings.fix_example:
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs && adduser -S nodejs -u 1001
USER nodejs
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

findings.description: Pod does not define security context, allowing privileged containers.
findings.recommendation: Add securityContext to pod spec with runAsNonRoot: true.
findings.fix_example:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: secure-pod
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 1000
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: myapp:latest

findings.description: S3 bucket does not have server-side encryption enabled.
findings.recommendation: Enable SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS encryption for the bucket.

findings.description: Dockerfile does not have HEALTHCHECK instruction.
findings.recommendation: Add HEALTHCHECK to enable container health monitoring.
